definition: a long thin strip of cloth or paper for fastening
description: In a clinic a woman in blue scrubs winds a long white cloth strip around a man's hand and wrist, pulling it tight in overlapping turns; more rolls of the same white strip sit on the counter behind. The camera pulls back and the joke lands: colleagues have wound the strip round and round his whole body and head until only his face shows, and everyone is laughing while two more people keep unrolling.
